# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 4: Little Ice Age, Silver Price Revolution, 12 Parliament Agendas & 6 Authentic Rebel Demands (oe_cri2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_crises.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Disaster 1: The Little Ice Age Crisis (1570-1715)
# Complements vanilla situations/little_ice_age.txt without touching it or its modifiers.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
oe_cri2_little_ice_age = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/time_of_troubles.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low
	fire_only_once = no

	can_start = {
		NOT = { oe_cri2_rule_is_off = yes }
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		OR = { NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes } oe_years_since_start >= 30 }
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_cri2_lia_cooldown }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_cri2_lia_resilient_agriculture }
		current_year >= 1570
		current_year <= 1715
		oe_cri2_lia_climate_zone = yes
		OR = {
			is_situation_active = situation:little_ice_age
			AND = {
				current_year >= 1570
				current_year < 1645
				oe_cri2_rule_is_historic = yes
			}
		}
		oe_cri2_lia_food_distress = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { oe_cri2_rule_is_mild = yes }
			stability < 15
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			oe_cri2_rule_is_off = yes
			current_year > 1715
			has_country_modifier = oe_cri2_lia_resilient_agriculture
			AND = {
				NOT = { any_province = { is_starving = yes } }
				capital ?= {
					market ?= {
						market_monthly_food_balance >= 0
					}
				}
				stability >= 20
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_cri2_lia_relief_score }
					var:oe_cri2_lia_relief_score >= 3
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		global_monthly_food_modifier = -0.20
		global_food_capacity_modifier = -0.15
		peasants_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.10
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.004
		global_monthly_prosperity = -0.004
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_cri2_lia_relief_score value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_cri2_rule_is_mild = yes }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cri2_mild_crisis_buffer years = -1 mode = replace }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cri2.1
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			5 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			95 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				95 = { }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_cri2.2 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_cri2.3 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_cri2.4 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_cri2.5 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_cri2.6 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		remove_country_modifier = oe_cri2_mild_crisis_buffer
		set_variable = { name = oe_cri2_lia_cooldown years = 30 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cri2.15
	}
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Disaster 2: The 16th-Century Silver Price Revolution (1540-1660)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
oe_cri2_silver_price_revolution = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/decline_of_empire.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low
	fire_only_once = no

	can_start = {
		NOT = { oe_cri2_rule_is_off = yes }
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		OR = { NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes } oe_years_since_start >= 30 }
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_cri2_silver_cooldown }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_cri2_silver_standard_reformed }
		has_global_variable = oe_cri2_silver_tide_active
		current_year >= 1540
		current_year <= 1660
		oe_cri2_silver_trade_exposed = yes
		OR = {
			AND = {
				oe_cri2_rule_is_historic = yes
				oe_cri2_silver_pressure_historic = yes
			}
			AND = {
				oe_cri2_rule_is_mild = yes
				oe_cri2_silver_pressure_mild = yes
			}
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		OR = {
			oe_cri2_rule_is_off = yes
			current_year > 1675
			has_country_modifier = oe_cri2_silver_standard_reformed
			AND = {
				inflation < 0.06
				stability >= 25
				is_during_bankruptcy = no
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_cri2_silver_reform_steps }
					var:oe_cri2_silver_reform_steps >= 2
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_inflation = 0.0012
		bank_interest = 0.025
		bond_interest = 0.025
		tax_income_efficiency = -0.15
		burghers_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.06
		peasants_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.06
		stability_cost_efficiency = -0.15
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_cri2_silver_reform_steps value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_cri2_rule_is_mild = yes }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cri2_mild_crisis_buffer years = -1 mode = replace }
		}
		oe_cri2_inject_silver_tide_markets = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cri2.7
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			5 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			95 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				94 = { }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_cri2.8 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_cri2.9 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_cri2.10 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_cri2.11 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_cri2.12 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = oe_cri2.14 }
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		remove_country_modifier = oe_cri2_mild_crisis_buffer
		set_variable = { name = oe_cri2_silver_cooldown years = 35 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cri2.13
	}
}
